sample_unit: chest radiographs (plus 7022 brain MR images and 270 radiograph pairs in reader study)

links.outcome: Saliency map sensitivity and robustness to subtle input perturbations (prediction-saliency correlation)
links.effect: Maximum PSC 0.25 for sensitivity and 0.12 for robustness on CheXpert; vendor prototype saliency unchanged despite 8.6% AUC drop; experts had less than 44.8% correctness identifying perturbed images.
links.quote: Popular saliency methods scored low PSC values on the two datasets of perturbed chest radiographs, indicating weak sensitivity and robustness.

screen.reason: Evaluates the robustness and reliability of saliency maps (a common explainability safeguard for medical imaging AI) under input perturbations, including a reader study with radiologists.
